clips.title: The story
paras: Wharfmaster Dizzywig has heard of a fist-sized emerald at the Venture Company's Boulder Lode Mine. He hires you to take the Cats Eye Emerald from the mine's supervisors and share the profits.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig hears the merchants who pass through Ratchet's harbor on the routes between Ratchet and Booty Bay. Word reaches him of a huge gem found deep in the Boulder Lode Mine. The Venture Company strips the northern Barrens for its own gain, so few are likely to ask questions if its finest recent find disappears.

Northeast of the Sludge Fen, laborers fill the Boulder Lode Mine's rocky shaft. The Venture Co. Overseers and Enforcers have taken the Cats Eye Emerald, and an ordinary digger cannot claim a prize so rare. You need to face the armed managers, secure the stone, and bring it to Dizzywig. He can judge its value against the market in Undermine.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Look at the size of that thing, friend! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!
Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, friend.
